en.topic_summary:
Fourteen people, including 12 civil servants currently working at the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD), have filed a lawsuit against a colleague over an office lottery dispute involving a HK$33 million Mark Six jackpot.



A betting branch of Hong Kong Jockey Club in 2023. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
